replacements.oldText: The repository currently has no shipped unit-comparison page or route. The comparison requirements remain planned and are not implementation-completion evidence. The page consumes the existing `GET /api/catalog` and `GET /api/units?id={id}` endpoints and extracts their `success`/`data` response envelopes. There is no dedicated comparison API route; comparison is assembled in the page from those existing catalog and unit endpoints. The comparison requirements and acceptance status remain subject to focused runtime proof and are not closed by this implementation reference.
